svg.title: The final message of an illustrated run
svg.desc: Compare with the S&P 500: A chart in a research app that shows how any stock has moved against the S&P 500 since the first day both have prices. Verdict: ready to ship. The split math matches a hand count and both lines start on the same day. Dividends are not counted yet. The moment: Type a ticker and both lines start at 0% on the same day, so the gap is the whole story Run: npm run dev, then open http://localhost:5173/compare Try first: 1) Type a ticker you hold and read the gap to the index 2) Pick a stock that split two for one and check the split day shows no drop 3) Pick a stock listed this year and see where both lines start Must not break: numbers passed (Percent change across a two-for-one split matches a hand count on 40 split cases, 0 failing) Review (claude-opus-5-5): 9 flagged, 7 fixed, 1 rejected, 1 deferred Judge rounds: 5 of 5 done, on the code and how it behaves, the UI and UX and whether it is ready to ship, and the last word was ready to ship Screen sizes: 0 broken, 2 weak, 15 sizes and 148 elements checked Asks: 9 of 9 closed Report: file:///Users/you/projects/research-app/.100x/REPORT.html Next likely asks: Count dividends in the comparison; Show the gap for several stocks in one table
